decisions.reason: Because Product A builds on the firm's established secure-communication offer and shows no sign of falling below its historical or comparable-firm aspirations, management keeps it and sets a low drop probability.

Product C aligns with the firm's move toward broader secure digital ecosystems and its own-page presentation suggests results meet aspirations, so the firm retains it with a low probability of discontinuation.

Although Product E is close to the established hardware token offer, its QR-code focus is somewhat narrower and more uncertain, but organisational slack and the absence of a clear shortfall justify keeping it with a moderate-low drop probability.

The payment network security compliance suite addresses stable regulatory demand and builds on established capabilities, so management judges it at or above aspirations and keeps it with a low drop probability.
